summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres addressed the Security Council's first debate on artificial intelligence, urging global governance and oversight. He highlighted AI's potential for good and its risks, including malicious use, disinformation, and autonomous weapons. He proposed a new UN entity for AI governance and called for urgent action.
entities: High-Level Advisory Board for Artificial Intelligence

claims.text: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just two months.
claims.evidence_quote: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just two months.

claims.text: AI could contribute between $10 and $15 trillion to the global economy by 2030.
claims.evidence_quote: The finance industry estimates AI could contribute between $10 and $15 trillion to the global economy by 2030.

claims.text: The High Commissioner for Human Rights has expressed alarm over evidence that AI can amplify bias, reinforce discrimination, and enable new levels of authoritarian surveillance.
claims.evidence_quote: the High Commissioner for Human Rights has expressed alarm over evidence that AI can amplify bias, reinforce discrimination and enable new levels of authoritarian surveillance.

claims.text: AI-enabled cyberattacks are already targeting critical infrastructure and UN peacekeeping and humanitarian operations.
claims.evidence_quote: AI-enabled cyberattacks are already targeting critical infrastructure and our own peacekeeping and humanitarian operations, causing great human suffering.

claims.text: The advent of generative AI could be a defining moment for disinformation and hate speech.
claims.evidence_quote: The advent of generative AI could be a defining moment for disinformation and hate speech — undermining truth, facts and safety, adding a new dimension to the manipulation of human behaviour and contributing to polarization and instability on a vast scale.

claims.text: Guterres agrees with experts recommending the prohibition of lethal autonomous weapons without human control.
claims.evidence_quote: I agree with the large number of experts that have recommended the prohibition of lethal autonomous weapons without human control.

claims.text: Guterres welcomed calls for a new UN entity for AI governance, inspired by IAEA, ICAO, or IPCC.
claims.evidence_quote: I therefore welcome calls from some Member States for the creation of a new United Nations entity to support collective efforts to govern this extraordinary technology, inspired by such models as the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) or the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.

claims.text: Guterres is convening a multistakeholder High-Level Advisory Board for Artificial Intelligence that will report back on options for global AI governance by the end of this year.
claims.evidence_quote: As a first step, I am convening a multistakeholder High-Level Advisory Board for Artificial Intelligence that will report back on the options for global AI governance, by the end of this year.

claims.text: The Policy Brief on a New Agenda for Peace will call for negotiations to be concluded by 2026 on a legally binding instrument to prohibit lethal autonomous weapons systems that function without human control or oversight.
claims.evidence_quote: The Policy Brief on a New Agenda for Peace will also call for negotiations to be concluded by 2026 on a legally binding instrument to prohibit lethal autonomous weapons systems that function without human control or oversight, and which cannot be used in compliance with international humanitarian law.

claims.text: Guterres urged agreement that human agency and control are essential for nuclear weapons and should never be withdrawn.
claims.evidence_quote: I urge agreement on the general principle that human agency and control are essential for nuclear weapons and should never be withdrawn.

claims.text: Guterres called for a race to develop AI for good, to end poverty, banish hunger, cure cancer, and supercharge climate action.
claims.evidence_quote: We need a race to develop AI for good: to develop AI that is reliable and safe and that can end poverty, banish hunger, cure cancer and supercharge climate action [and] an AI that propels us towards the Sustainable Development Goals.
